from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyUndistributedProfit(BaseModel):
    """One company's undistributed profit figure from its financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name in the report")
    undistributed_profit: float | None = Field(description="The undistributed profit amount as reported")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit of the amount, e.g., '元'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the undistributed profit value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_undistributed_profits: list[CompanyUndistributedProfit]
